$comment: Files and marked sections owned by the generic agent kit (agentic-nx-monorepo). Stack-specific content lives in stack-owned files or <!-- stack:... --> sections. `tools/kit-sync.mjs` (added later) copies these from the kit repo; do not put stack-specific content in them.

notYetGeneric.tools/dev-ports.mjs: its services (web/api/db ports, the /graphql path, Postgres URLs and database names) are this stack's; it joins the kit once they come from stack config

merged..claude/settings.json: kit provides env, hooks, base permissions and plugins; stacks may add permissions and plugins
merged..oxlintrc.json: kit provides base rules; ignorePatterns are rendered by agents:sync
merged..oxfmtrc.json: kit provides base options; ignorePatterns are rendered by agents:sync
merged..gitattributes: kit provides the base and the linguist-generated block rendered by agents:sync; stacks add their own entries
